title: Generalize class progression resolver from level-1 to arbitrary class level rows
description: rulesPackResolver.ts currently parses only a level-1 slice: ResolvedClassData.level1 (type ResolvedClassLevel1), built by parseLevel1(progression) which finds the level-1 row. Generalize this seam to resolve any level row from the pack's progression table — e.g. resolveClassLevel(classKey, level) or classRecord.progression[level] — returning proficiency bonus, features (with refs) granted at that level, and spellcasting cantrips-known / slots-by-level. Preserve the existing level-1 behavior that character creation depends on. Pure read layer over already-present pack data.
acceptance_criteria: Resolver returns a typed level-N row for any supported class/level; malformed/missing rows surface as resolution errors; unit tests cover martial (no spellcasting) and caster classes across several levels.
notes: In progress in parallel via Codex (separate PR). Do not double-claim.
close_reason: Implemented typed arbitrary class progression level resolution with tests.
